passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.1
passages.text: Extremum hunc, Arethusa, mihi concede laborem:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.2
passages.text: pauca meo Gallo, sed quae legat ipsa Lycoris,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.3
passages.text: carmina sunt dicenda. neget quis carmina Gallo?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.4
passages.text: sic tibi, cum fluctus subterlabere Sicanos,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.5
passages.text: Doris amara suam non intermisceat undam.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.6
passages.text: incipe; sollicitos Galli dicamus amores,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.7
passages.text: dum tenera attondent simae virgulta capellae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.8
passages.text: non canimus surdis; respondent omnia silvae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.9
passages.text: Quae nemora, aut qui vos saltus habuere, puellae

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.10
passages.text: Naides, indigno cum Gallus amore peribat?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.11
passages.text: nam neque Parnasi vobis iuga, nam neque Pindi

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.12
passages.text: ulla moram fecere, neque Aoniae Aganippe.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.13
passages.text: Illum etiam lauri, etiam flevere myricae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.14
passages.text: Pinifer illum etiam sola sub rupe iacentem

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.15
passages.text: Maenalus, et gelidi fleverunt saxa Lycaei.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.16
passages.text: Stant et oves circum;—nostri nec poenitet illas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.17
passages.text: nec te poeniteat pecoris, divine poeta;—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.18
passages.text: et formosus ovis ad flumina pavit Adonis;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.19
passages.text: venit et upilio; tardi venere subulci;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.20
passages.text: uvidus hiberna venit de glande Menalcas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.21
passages.text: Omnes “Unde amor iste” rogant “tibi?” Venit Apollo:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.22
passages.text: “Galle, quid insanis?” inquit; “tua cura Lycoris

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.23
passages.text: perque nives alium perque horrida castra secuta est.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.24
passages.text: Venit et agresti capitis Silvanus honore,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.25
passages.text: florentis ferulas et grandia lilia quassans.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.26
passages.text: Pan deus Arcadiae venit, quem vidimus ipsi

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.27
passages.text: sanguineis ebuli bacis minioque rubentem.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.28
passages.text: “Ecquis erit modus?” inquit; “Amor non talia curat;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.29
passages.text: nec lacrimis crudelis Amor, nec gramina rivis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.30
passages.text: nec cytiso saturantur apes, nec fronde capellae.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.31
passages.text: Tristis at ille: “Tamen cantabitis, Arcades,” inquit

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.32
passages.text: “montibus haec vestris: soli cantare periti

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.33
passages.text: Arcades. O mihi tum quam molliter ossa quiescant,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.34
passages.text: vestra meos olim si fistula dicat amores!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.35
passages.text: Atque utinam ex vobis unus, vestrique fuissem

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.36
passages.text: aut custos gregis, aut maturae vinitor uvae!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.37
passages.text: Certe, sive mihi Phillis, sive esset Amyntas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.38
passages.text: seu quicumque furor—quid tum, si fuscus Amyntas;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.39
passages.text: et nigrae violae sunt et vaccinia nigra—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.40
passages.text: mecum inter salices lenta sub vite iaceret;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.41
passages.text: serta mihi Phyllis legeret, cantaret Amyntas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.42
passages.text: Hic gelidi fontes, hic mollia prata, Lycori,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.43
passages.text: hic nemus; hic ipso tecum consumerer aevo.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.44
passages.text: Nunc insanus amor duri me Martis in armis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.45
passages.text: tela inter media atque adversos detinet hostes:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.46
passages.text: tu procul a patria (nec sit mihi credere tantum!)

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.47
passages.text: Alpinas, ah dura, nives et frigora Rheni

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.48
passages.text: me sine sola vides: ah, te ne frigora laedant!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.49
passages.text: ah, tibi ne teneras glacies secet aspera plantas!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.50
passages.text: Ibo, et, Chalcidico quae sunt mihi condita versu

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.51
passages.text: carmina, pastoris Siculi modulabor avena.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.52
passages.text: certum est in silvis, inter spelaea ferarum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.53
passages.text: malle pati, tenerisque meos incidere amores

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.54
passages.text: arboribus; crescent illae, crescetis, amores.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.55
passages.text: Interea mixtis lustrabo Maenala nymphis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.56
passages.text: aut acris venabor apros: non me ulla vetabunt

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.57
passages.text: frigora Parthenios canibus circumdare saltus.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.58
passages.text: iam mihi per rupes videor lucosque sonantis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.59
passages.text: ire; libet Partho torquere Cydonia cornu

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.60
passages.text: spicula:—tamquam haec sit nostri medicina furoris,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.61
passages.text: ut deus ille malis hominum mitescere discat!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.62
passages.text: Iam neque hamadryades rursus nec carmina nobis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.63
passages.text: ipsa placent; ipsae rursus concedite silvae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.64
passages.text: non illum nostri possunt mutare labores,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.65
passages.text: nec si frigoribus mediis Hebrumque bibamus,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.66
passages.text: Sithoniasque nives hiemis subeamus aquosae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.67
passages.text: nec si, cum moriens alta liber aret in ulmo,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.68
passages.text: Aethiopum versemus ovis sub sidere Cancri.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.69
passages.text: omnia vincit Amor; et nos cedamus Amori.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.70
passages.text: Haec sat erit, divae, vestrum cecinisse poetam,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.71
passages.text: dum sedet et gracili fiscellam texit hibisco,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.72
passages.text: Pierides; vos haec facietis maxima Gallo—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.73
passages.text: Gallo, cuius amor tantum mihi crescit in horas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.74
passages.text: quantum vere novo viridis se subicit alnus.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.75
passages.text: Surgamus; solet esse gravis cantantibus umbra;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.76
passages.text: iuniperi gravis umbra; nocent et frugibus umbrae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 10.77
passages.text: Ite domum saturae, venit Hesperus, ite capellae.
